# Simulation set-up

```{r include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
n_rep <- 100
n <- 10
conf_level <- 0.95
SCR_type <- 'Fix t'
grid_t <- '[0,1], 21 grids'
grid_x <- '[-10, 10] 4000 grids'
estimating_method <- 'CV'
basis_used <- 'Legendre'

info_df <- data.frame(n_rep, n, conf_level, SCR_type, grid_t, grid_x, estimating_method, basis_used, basis_used)

knitr::kable(info_df, caption = 'Simulation information')
```

# Data generation function
$$X_i = m(t_i, X_{i-1}) + \sigma(t_i, X_{i-1})\epsilon_i$$
where 
$$m(t,x) = (1+x^2)^{-4} + sin(2\pi t)\exp(-x^2)$$
$$\sigma(t,x) = 1.5\exp(-x^2/2)(2+\sin(2\pi t))$$

and 3 models for $\epsilon_i$ are constructed by $a_1(i/n) = 0.3$, $a_2(i/n) = 0.3 \sin(2\pi i/n)$

$$\epsilon_i = \sum_{j=1}^2 a_j(j/n) \epsilon_{i-j} + \eta_i, \quad \eta_i \sim_{iid} N(0,1) \tag{Time-varying AR(2)}$$
$$\epsilon_i = \begin{cases}
a_1(i/n)\epsilon_{i-1} + \eta_i, \quad \eta_i \sim_{iid} N(0,1), &\epsilon_i \ge 0 \\
a_2(i/n)\epsilon_{i-1} + \eta_i, \quad \eta_i \sim_{iid} N(0,1), & \epsilon_i < 0
\end{cases} \tag{Self-exciting threshold auto-regressive (SETAR)}$$

$$
\epsilon_i = (a_1(i/n)\eta_{i-1} + a_2(i/n))\epsilon_{i-1} + \eta_i, \quad \eta_i \sim_{iid} N(0,1) \tag{Bilinear}
$$

# Implementation
```{r eval=FALSE}
n_options <- 10 # c(500, 800)
eps_options <- c('tvAR2', 'SETAR', 'bilinear')
m_case = 1

n_rep = 100 #c(500, 2000, 5000)

for (n in n_options) {
  res <- list()
  
  for (eps in eps_options) {
    cat('Running case n=', n, eps, '\n')
    cov <- auto_SCR_coverage(n_rep = n_rep, n=n, f_true=m2, delta=1, m_case = m_case, eps_case = eps)
    res[paste0('n=', n,'_', eps)] <- cov
  }
}

auto_SCR_coverage <- function(n_rep = 10, n = 100, t_grid = seq(0, 1, length.out = 21),
                              c = 10, d = 10, b_time = 'Legen', b_timese = 'Legen',
                              mp_type = 'algeb', type = 'fixt', ops = 'CV', per=0.2,
                              r=1, s=1, upper=10, f_true, delta=0, m_case, eps_case = 'tvAR2') {
  covered <- logical(n_rep)
  for (s in (1:n_rep)) {
    cat('Running replication s=', s, ' out of ', n_rep, '\n')
    ok_all_t <- TRUE
    set.seed(s)
    ts <- sim_x(n, delta, m_case = m_case, eps_case = eps_case)
    for (t0 in t_grid[2:(length(t_grid)-1)]) {
      res <- auto.SCR(ts, c=10, d=10, b_time = 'Legen', b_timese = 'Legen', 
                      mp_type='algeb', type = 'fixt', ops = 'CV', t0, per = 0.2)
      df <- res[[1]]
      
      band <- extract_band(df)
      
      m_true <- f_true(t=rep(t0, length(band$x)), x=band$x, delta=delta)
      
      covered_t <- all(m_true >= band$lower & m_true <= band$upper)
      if (!covered_t) {ok_all_t <- FALSE; break}
    }
    covered[s] <- ok_all_t
    cat('covered=', covered, '\n')
    
  }
  return(mean(covered))
  
}
```
